title: Tests, functions, expressions
description:
Tests, global functions and expressions (`:help dbdash-templates`): each row is a
template as written and what it gave.

show.title: tests: x is name
show.description:
Every test, as `x is name` (and `is not`), and the comparison tests that
`select` / `selectattr` take by name or symbol.

show.title: expressions: numbers, strings, tuples, slices, formatting
show.description:
Operators (`//`, `%`, `**`, `~`, chained comparisons, `in`, `and` / `or` /
`not`), literals (tuples, mappings, `1e3`, `0x1f`, `1_000`), slices, and
formatting with `%` and `str.format()`.
